भड् (इ) भडि r. 1st cl. (भण्डते)
 1. To rally. to deride or treat with merri-
ment.
 2. To jest, to joke.
 3. To speak.
 4. To upbraid, to reprove.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (भण्डते भण्डयति-ते) To do an auspicious act.

भडिल m. (-लः)
 1. A servant.
 2. A hero.
 E. भड् a Sautra root, to be
happy, Unādi aff. इलच् ।
